summary: Iteration-19: tested commitment checkboxes, cancel-preview dialog math, and Google-Maps directions buttons. Backend pytest 3/3 pass: (a) requester cancel of a confirmed VIP calendar booking returns refund=50% / comp=25% / fee=25% and the client's balance increases by exactly the refund amount, (b) VIP cancel returns 100% refund with comp=fee=0, (c) target booking 59cd396e... is confirmed and carries location {address,lat,lng}. Frontend Playwright: vs-book-dialog on VIP profile exposes all commitment testids (vs-book-commitment, vs-book-commitment-terms, vs-book-commitment-privacy, vs-book-commitment-checkbox) and vs-book-submit is disabled with the checkbox unticked and flips to enabled only after ticking (a time is auto-picked). On /vip-bookings as admin, the target booking shows vs-cancel-{id} and vs-directions-{id}; the directions href is 'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=51.5237%2C-0.1585' (lat,lng as expected). Cancel preview dialog shows paid=500, refund=250, comp=125, fee=125; cancel-preview-keep closes the dialog without cancelling. Spanish language renders the cancel preview correctly (title '¿Cancelar esta cita?', 'Mantener cita', 'Sí, cancelar').

issues: Commitment checkbox and submit button sit at the bottom of the Sheet and are below the viewport fold on 1920x1080 — the user must scroll inside the Sheet to see the 'I agree' tick box. Consider sticking the commitment+submit footer so the gating is always visible.

action_items: Optional: make the commitment note + submit sticky inside vs-book-dialog so users don't have to scroll to find the required checkbox.
critical_code_review_comments: CancelPreviewDialog uses Math.round for refund+comp — fee is derived as remainder (total - refund - comp). For total=500 this gives 250/125/125 (matches backend). Good consistency.

DirectionsButton falls back to a comma-joined address when lat/lng are missing — this is good; verify postal_code/country are populated in all booking types (DateBookingList passes the raw booking object; vip_sched/date_bookings must populate location consistently).
server.py still 5563 lines — split long overdue (noted in iter 15-18 as well).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_cancel_directions.py (3 tests, ~3s). Note: /api/users/me does NOT exist — balances come from /api/auth/me. VIP slots endpoint is /api/vip/schedule/{vip_id}/slots and each slot has fields {start,end,state} where state='available' means bookable. POST /api/vip/schedule/{vip_id}/book returns {booking_id,status}; coins are read via /api/vip/schedule/bookings/mine. The target booking 59cd396e-4b32-43b1-87fa-6ef7f11cebdd (Sat 17 Oct 12:00-13:00, 221B Baker Street, lat 51.5237 lng -0.1585) is confirmed and should remain so for future directions-button retests. Avoid cancelling it.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Only UX nit: the commitment checkbox inside the VIP calendar Sheet is below the viewport fold on desktop; functionality is correct.
